messages:
sara-eng: Quick sync — we need to finalize what we ship as "SM slot health" metrics for Hosted + Dedicated pools. Goal: single dashboard + alert set that product/ops can use.

miguel-infra: +1. which signals are you thinking? occupancy, mem, queue depth? sampling freq?

sara-eng: Exactly: SM occupancy (percent of warps/threads in use), GPU memory per-slot (used/total), queue depth (per-pool and per-slot buckets), and backpressure rate. Target 30s rollup, 5m for alerting.

dave-ml: For occupancy please avoid per-container labels. Low-cardinality is key. Metric names I propose: `redwood_sm_occupancy_pct`, `redwood_gpu_memory_bytes_used`, `redwood_queue_depth_bucket` (histogram).

miguel-infra: Agree on names. Implementation note: the runtime exporter currently exposes per-device SM util and per-process mem. We'll need a small shim to aggregate to slot-level for Dedicated.

jen-product: We also need to show hosted vs dedicated and customer quotas on the dashboard. Product wants a per-customer view (quota usage vs allocated) — how do we avoid cardinality explosion?

dave-ml: For per-customer we should pre-aggregate for the top N customers and have an "other" bucket. Don't expose raw request_id or user tokens as labels.

alla-sre: Alerting proposals: critical when occupancy > 95% p95 for 10m, or queue depth p99 > 50 for 5m. Memory: any slot > 90% memory sustained for 3m -> notify. We need runbook links in alerts.

sara-eng: Sounds good. UX: dashboard should have a top-level summary row (global occupancy, avg queue depth, total reserved slots), then split panels for hosted vs dedicated, and a customer quota panel with sparkline for top 10 tenants.

miguel-infra: Telemetry details: ingestion pipeline is prometheus -> remote_write -> tempo/grafana. Current scrape interval is 15s for runtime. I'm ok with 30s rollups if we do histogram buckets for queue depth.

dave-ml: Example PromQL for sm occupancy p95 (suggested):
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, redwood_sm_occupancy_pct[5m])
```
Use `avg by (pool)` for pool-level.

jen-product: On rollout UX: product wants a toggle in the Console to switch quota view between allocated vs used and to see projected exhaustion time. That requires a derived metric or a small query service.

miguel-infra: We can expose `redwood_customer_slot_allocated` and `redwood_customer_slot_in_use` (low-cardinality label set: customer_id, pool_type). Derived exhaustion time = (allocated - in_use)/avg_consumption_rate. We'll compute in a dashboard/transform.

alla-sre: Ownership: eng-platform to own metric schema + exporter changes; eng-runtime to add aggregation shim; product to own dashboard UX + runbooks; alert policies owned by eng-sre.

sara-eng: Proposed owners pinned: miguel-infra (metric schema + deploy), dave-ml (query patterns + percentiles), jen-product (console UX + quota panel), alla-sre (alerts + runbook). Can everyone ack?

miguel-infra: ack, will open PR with schema + example exporter patch. ETA: 1 week for prototype.

dave-ml: ack. I'll prototype promql panels and a recorder rule set for p95/p99.

jen-product: ack. I'll wire the Console mock and spec the API for projected exhaustion.

alla-sre: ack. I'll draft alert thresholds and a short runbook.

opsbot: Deployment note: when the exporter changes land, we'll need a staggered rollout to avoid a spike in cardinality to the remote_write cluster. Use canary on dedicated pool first.

sara-eng: Action items: (1) miguel open schema PR with metric names + labels, (2) dave produce dashboard JSON + promql examples, (3) jen spec Console toggle & API, (4) alla draft alerts+runbook. Weekly sync Friday.

miguel-infra: I'll include a small example aggregation script in the PR.

dave-ml: Posting sample panel queries to the PR in a bit.

sara-eng: Thanks team — want a short meeting Thu if needed, otherwise we'll reconvene Fri. :thumbsup:
